:::{#sol-cv-estimate-by-fold}

The [folds](#def-folds) $\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{\nfolds}$ partition $\obsidx$,
so summing over the observations of each fold and then over the folds
adds each term of @eq-cv-estimate exactly once:

$$
\ba
\cvest{\nfolds}
&= \frac{1}{\nobs} \sum_{\iobs \in \obsidx} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{\iobs}}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}
&& \text{(definition)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{\nobs} \sumto{\ifold}{\nfolds} \sum_{\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{\iobs}}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}
&& \text{(group by fold)}
\ea
$$

:::
